evals.name: littera-user-rewrite
evals.prompt: Rewrite the README in this repository for end users. It is too long and has no screenshot. I put a current screenshot of the settings window at screenshot.png in the repository root; use it. I approve the short outline, so write it now.
evals.expected_output: A short user-facing README with the supplied screenshot after the pitch, user install and usage steps, and moved developer detail.
expectations: README.md exists and is a Markdown README
A non-banner image appears after the pitch and before the requirements heading, and its file exists
Requirements, install, usage, troubleshooting and license headings appear in that order, with license last
Prose is under 500 words
The README contains no em dashes and no placeholders
The install section contains a fenced code block
Every relative image and link path resolves

evals.name: gui-with-screenshot
evals.prompt: Write a README for this desktop app. A current screenshot of the main window is in assets/app.png. I approve the short outline, so write it now.
evals.expected_output: A short user-facing README with the screenshot after the pitch, requirements, install, usage, troubleshooting and license.
expectations: README.md exists and is a Markdown README
A non-banner image appears after the pitch and before the requirements heading, and its file exists
Requirements, install, usage, troubleshooting and license headings appear in that order, with license last
Prose is under 500 words
The README contains no em dashes and no placeholders
The install section contains a fenced code block
Every relative image and link path resolves
Architecture, build and release detail no longer appears in README.md and appears in DEVELOPMENT.md
README.md links to DEVELOPMENT.md

evals.name: gui-without-screenshot
evals.prompt: Write a README for this desktop app.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks for a screenshot and writes no README because the GUI app has no screenshot and capture is unavailable.
expectations: No README.md is created in the repository
The final response asks for a screenshot
No image file is created in the repository

expectations: README.md exists and is a Markdown README
Requirements, install, usage, troubleshooting and license headings appear in that order, with license last
